name.en: Use evidence to challenge a specific statement

summary.zh: 不是猜凶手，而是指出这句话与哪条事实冲突。
summary.en: Challenge the conflict between a claim and a fact rather than simply guessing the culprit.

rules.zh: 对方给出一组可以逐句审视的陈述，玩家将某份证据对应到其中一句。只有证据内容与该陈述确实冲突时，质询才推进；成功后证词被补充或改写，产生下一处可检查的矛盾。
rules.en: A speaker makes statements that can be examined individually. Match evidence to a specific statement; a real contradiction advances the questioning. The resulting clarification or revised testimony creates the next claim to inspect.

decisions.zh: 已经找到明确矛盾就反驳，还是先追问补齐上下文？
decisions.en: Object to a clear contradiction now or ask for more context first?

decisions.zh: 两份证据都相关时，哪份能直接推翻这句话？
decisions.en: When two items are relevant, which one directly disproves this claim?

name.zh: 证据与陈述的对应范围

effect.zh: 一份证据可反驳多个合理陈述，会减少“只认作者指定句”的挫败感。
effect.en: Accepting multiple valid matches reduces the frustration of guessing one author-selected line.

effect.zh: 轻罚鼓励验证假设；重罚要求更清楚的文字与复查机会。
effect.en: Light penalties encourage hypotheses; heavy penalties require clearer wording and opportunities to review.

cases.gameZh: 逆转裁判123 成步堂精选集

implementation.zh: 盘问时玩家可以追问证人，并对相应证词出示法庭记录中的证据，揭露其中的矛盾。
implementation.en: During cross-examination, players can press witnesses and present evidence from the court record against a corresponding statement.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：法庭场景中可见角色发言与证据记录入口；没有展示提交证据的完整过程。
observation.en: System reference: The courtroom scene shows dialogue and access to the Court Record; the complete evidence-submission sequence is not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

cases.gameZh: 弹丸论破：希望的学园与绝望的高中生

implementation.zh: 学级裁判把调查所得证据变成言弹；玩家选用匹配证据，在辩论中的矛盾陈述上进行反驳。
implementation.en: Class Trials turn collected evidence into Truth Bullets, which players match to contradictory statements during the debate.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：字母选择小游戏与倒计时可见；这张图没有展示用证据反驳的操作。
observation.en: System reference: A letter-selection minigame and timer are visible; an evidence-based rebuttal is not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 逆转裁判强调逐句选择与出示；弹丸论破还把证据匹配放进持续滚动的辩论操作中。
contrast.en: Ace Attorney emphasizes selecting a statement and presenting evidence; Danganronpa also places the match inside an active debate interface.

combination.zh: 组合提案：未鉴定的物证只有模糊描述；花资源化验后出现精确时间或材质，才能推翻更具体的证词。
combination.en: Design proposal: unidentified evidence has only a vague description. Paying for analysis reveals a precise time or material that can challenge a more specific statement.

setup.zh: 证人说八点听到了钟声，记录表明钟在七点半停摆。
setup.en: A witness heard the clock at eight, but a record says it stopped at seven thirty.

action.zh: 玩家对“八点响钟”这句出示维修记录。
action.en: The player presents the repair record against the claim about eight o’clock.

result.zh: 证人改口说时间来自墙上的电子屏。
result.en: The witness revises the source of the time to an electronic display.

next.zh: 玩家再检查电子屏的位置，寻找新的矛盾。
next.en: The player checks the display’s location for the next contradiction.

firstStep.zh: 做三句证词、三张证据卡和一次改口，不先写完整案件。
firstStep.en: Build three statements, three evidence cards and one revision before writing a full case.

pitfall.zh: 相关不等于矛盾；需要说明证据如何否定陈述，避免猜作者意图。
pitfall.en: Relevance is not contradiction: make the logical conflict clear instead of asking players to guess author intent.

test.zh: 玩家能否不用穷举，就用自己的话解释这一对为什么冲突？
test.en: Can players explain the conflict without brute-forcing every pair?
